## Experience

- **Workstate / Compass** (Apr 2026 to Jul 2026), Backend Engineer. Go services and REST APIs for a leading US real estate platform. Rebuilt a core Go microservice and cut P95 latency by 90%.
- **NEORIS / The Home Depot US** (Dec 2025 to Mar 2026), Backend Developer. Led planning and development of Go gRPC microservices for inventory management on GCP.
- **Personally AI** (Oct 2025 to Nov 2025), Backend Developer Consultant. RAG chatbot on WhatsApp for a presidential campaign, running a local model on Ollama, with 1 000+ active users.
- **Mercado Libre** (Jun 2021 to Sep 2025), Cybersecurity Developer, IAM. Go and Python microservices for the identity and access platform: 1 000 000+ daily requests, 40 000+ employees and 100 000+ external partners.
